command: bash -c 'for tool in elan lean lake leanchecker; do command -v "$tool" || true; done; if command -v elan >/dev/null; then elan toolchain list; fi; for dir in /root/.elan/toolchains /root/.cache/mathlib /root/.cache/lean; do if [ -d "$dir" ]; then ls -ld "$dir" "$dir"/*; fi; done; if [ -d .lake ]; then ls -la .lake; fi'
